about: Runtime-side configuration, never on the wire -- the same rule mandate.md states for the authorization envelope. `bindings` is the operator saying which tool means which capability; a runtime MUST NOT guess one from a tool's name, and an unbound tool is reported unjudged rather than assumed harmless.

lower_trust.about: `sources` may only ever LOWER trust. A failed DMARC does not prove the content is an attack -- it proves nobody vouched for the sender, which is exactly the case where an action derived from it should not proceed unseen.

note: No rule names memory.write, memory.read, mail.read or message.reply. Read-only and internal capabilities carry no provenance rule at all -- that is what makes the deliberately conservative propagation in provenance.md affordable: almost every action an agent takes never reaches a rule.
